children: Avista affirmed 2026 non-GAAP utility earnings guidance of $2.52 to $2.72 per diluted share and outlined a $3.6 billion capital plan for 2027–2031.
The 2027–2031 capital plan supports utility investment; projected rate base compound annual growth is 7.3%.
Avista signed an MOU seeking a 10% stake in the North Plains Connector, a proposed 420-mile, 3,000-megawatt transmission line.
The connector’s estimated cost is $6 billion; definitive agreements are expected in 6–9 months, with financial commitments likely in 2032.
A decision on Avista’s Washington general rate case is expected in mid-December 2026.
For the year, Avista assumes $615 million in capital expenditures and normal weather for the remainder of 2026.

title: Avista Affirms 2026 Utility Earnings Guidance, Plans $3.6 Billion Investment
